spanish: Largo de la cortina la una: treinta en el codo, y cuatro codos el ancho de la cortina la una; medida una a las once cortinas.

findings.issue: las marks the eleven curtains as definite; the lamed is a bare preposition (HR, not HRd) and the curtain noun is absolute plural with no article.

notes: Length, both the-one curtain phrases, thirty in the (definite) singular cubit, and four plural cubits match the tokens.
